BiblicalUsage: esṓteros is the word for interior. It occurs twice, in Acts and Hebrews.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe esṓteros is best left as Scripture leaves it: interior.
RelatedEvents: Paul's Missionary Journeys; Paul and Silas in the Philippian Prison
